turnaround_reason: Coty has been de-rated as beauty demand softened and the balance sheet stayed levered. Management is running a divestiture-plus-cost-cut program (monetized Wella, sold the Gucci Beauty license back to Kering) to shrink debt and refocus on core brands while like-for-like sales are still falling.
bullish_points: Aggressive deleveraging: $750M from the remaining Wella stake (Dec 2025) plus $400M from selling Gucci Beauty back to Kering (Jul 2026)
Strong FY2026 free cash flow of ~$348M despite a >$200M EBITDA decline
Recovering above the 100d MA (109%) and 200d MA; trading near $2.66 vs. 52w high $4.47
Very low implied vol (~6% ATM) makes long-dated calls cheap if you want convexity
bearish_points: Turnaround is incomplete: full-year like-for-like sales fell 5%; volumes, excess inventory and tariffs still pressure gross profit
FY2027 guided as a transition year with an EBITDA target only above $50M — a low bar
Debt/equity ~97.5 remains high even after asset sales
No insider buying in last 6 months; -6% over trailing 30 days shows momentum is not yet convincing
catalyst: Sequential improvement in like-for-like sales and margin plus continued debt paydown; a clean FY2027 quarter that confirms the transition-year inflection
suggested_trade: Spot small starter, or cheap long-dated 2027 calls given the ~6% IV; add only on a confirmed LFL-sales inflection
key_risk: Beauty demand stays soft and deleveraging stalls, leaving a levered, low-growth business with no re-rating trigger
would_skip_if: You want evidence the top line has actually inflected; right now it is still a promise, not a print
